goal: Build Perfpal, a static-analysis tool that extracts performance-relevant heuristics from codebases, renders insightful visual bottleneck maps, and emits LLM-consumable quantifiable metrics to enable AI-driven optimization.
current_phase: Perfpal Atlas: V7 prototypes done (F/G, 12/12 blind reads); G core, F components supporting (not fallback); next = research/planning map-shipped, developer-needs research first; no implementation.

decisions.title: V4 SHIPPED + DUAL-APPROVED (round 2). KV1 text-first brief, KV2 dependents bars, KV3 cost bars with dual bar scale; first screen KV1; 8 stems under #explorer; units/anchors + counted demotions; schema 1.7 additive (files[].path_class, stats.functions[].trip_count_source/known_trip_value); profile-queue.md/.html + findings-detail#ranked-actions; only ARCH-002 suppressed from KV1; scripts/ -> bench; 900px card rule recorded. Vision evidence docs/evidence/map-vision/v4/. A1b NOT claimed closed on severity; shipped ranks recorded; KV2 no production-first (V2 lock).

V5 DONE (evidence; dual-APPROVED). 18/18 valid blind reads (2 per key view; 3 empty agent outputs retried) state the slot question + one concrete path:line/function action; renders byte-identical to V4 (docs/evidence/map-vision/v5/). KV3 no-loop falsifier PARTIALLY FALSIFIED: guard demotes all three Q3 targets but is not the sole cause; counterfactual ranks 820->325, 58->46, 60->45 (still outside top 8). V7 must adopt call-weighted/per-iteration ranking or a call-frequency view; cJSON target is reachable_from_entry=false. Non-blocking O1 KV2 top N% wording, O2 KV2 production-first evidence. No code change. Holdout intact; map-build NOT done; A1b NOT closed.

V6 pre-test founder decisions: KV2 production-first amendment APPROVED (implement + re-validate with 2 blind reads per design-repo KV2 view; holdout untouched); randomized KV1 pair re-run SKIPPED (founder timed test is the decisive gate; V3 2/3 stands, recorded as accepted non-blocking). Holdout release for V6: scan both django + postgres, timed test on postgres (C path at scale), django untimed smoke; no agent reads of holdout key views.

V6a DONE: KV2 production-first amendment (ratified): production first -> dependents desc -> path; top P% follows that key; median over all files; 8 production + 2 grey demoted, never excluded; N demoted printed. cJSON.h #1; 6/6 blind reads PASS (docs/evidence/map-vision/v6/kv2-amendment/). Tests + 4 goldens (caption-only, stable). No schema change. Holdout scanned, never read. V5 byte-identical claim historical.

V6 SCRAPPED (founder): timed test waived; external review accepted as input; signal recorded; reconciliation doc docs/research/map-external-review-reconciliation-2026-10-22.md; stop criterion likely triggered; no implementation.

CONSOLIDATION AGREED: one core + 3 consumers, separate gates: A agent report, H human map, P paper (parked). Sequence agent -> map -> JS/TS -> paper. H: Explorer opt-in; KV1 = brief + agent seed; KV2/KV3 -> drill/Explorer.
HUMAN MAP DIRECTION (founder): entry-flow (G) proposed; F not selected; F/G prototypes built; animation mandatory (CSS/SMIL, ADR-0002 amendment); 12/12 blind reads.

FOUNDER CORRECTION (2026-10-22): G is the CORE graph; F is NOT a fallback and not discarded — F-derived components (weight/treemap mass, production-first area, component cells) are supporting elements, included only if developer-needs research justifies them. Graph page = 100% graph; metrics/brief below/elsewhere. Next: research/planning only (plan map-shipped): developer-needs research first, then metrics standardization, data-gap audit, full-page combined layout, component-inclusion rule, naming, spec/ADR, build plan. 12/12 blind reads; A2 holdout final gate. Feature name: Perfpal Atlas.
